purpose.zh: 在显式 --project 根下检查 Claude settings.local.json 的 UTF-8 语法与对象根。
purpose.en: With an explicit --project root, check UTF-8 syntax and an object root for Claude settings.local.json.

limitation.zh: 仅在提供 --project 时生成；不合并配置、不读账户、不判定本地覆盖是否生效。
limitation.en: Emitted only with --project; no merge evaluation, account checks, or proof that local overrides apply.

purpose.zh: 在显式 --project 根下检查 Claude 项目 settings.json 的 UTF-8 语法与对象根。
purpose.en: With an explicit --project root, check UTF-8 syntax and an object root for the Claude project settings.json.

limitation.zh: 仅在提供 --project 时生成；不向祖先遍历，不计算最终合并配置。
limitation.en: Emitted only with --project; ancestors are not walked and effective merged configuration is not computed.

purpose.zh: 检查用户层 Claude settings.json 的 UTF-8 语法与对象根。
purpose.en: Check UTF-8 syntax and an object root for the user-layer Claude settings.json.

limitation.zh: 文件可缺省；语法通过不等于登录、API 或服务可用；不输出配置键值。
limitation.en: The file may be absent; valid syntax does not establish login, API or service availability; config values are not exported.

purpose.zh: 观察已识别 Claude 入口所需的运行时线索（原生或 Node）。
purpose.en: Observe runtime clues required by a recognized Claude launcher (native or Node).

limitation.zh: 只覆盖入口所需运行时；不验证完整依赖树或全部可选功能。
limitation.en: Covers launcher runtime only; the full dependency tree and optional features are not validated.

purpose.zh: 根据入口布局观察 Claude 安装形式是否可识别。
purpose.en: Observe whether the Claude installation kind is recognizable from the launcher layout.

limitation.zh: 不是签名或发行方验证；未知形式不等于未安装。
limitation.en: Not signature or publisher verification; an unknown kind does not prove absence of an installation.

purpose.zh: 在 PATH/PATHEXT 限定模型下观察 Claude 入口候选与安装组线索。
purpose.en: Observe Claude PATH/PATHEXT candidates and installation-group clues under the limited resolution model.

limitation.zh: 不扫描磁盘；不预测别名/函数；受限扫描不能证明未安装或无重复。
limitation.en: No disk search; aliases/functions are outside prediction; a limited scan cannot prove absence or uniqueness.

purpose.zh: 对已识别 Claude 入口做有界 --version 观察。
purpose.en: Perform a bounded --version observation against a recognized Claude launcher.

limitation.zh: 仅接受短且完整匹配的版本响应；通过只覆盖本次查询，不验证服务或任务。
limitation.en: Only short complete version responses are accepted; a pass covers this query only, not service or task availability.

purpose.zh: 在显式 --project 根下检查 Codex 项目 config.toml 的 UTF-8 语法与对象根。
purpose.en: With an explicit --project root, check UTF-8 syntax and an object root for the Codex project config.toml.

limitation.zh: 仅在提供 --project 时生成；不向祖先遍历，不计算最终合并配置。
limitation.en: Emitted only with --project; ancestors are not walked and effective merged configuration is not computed.

purpose.zh: 检查用户层 Codex config.toml 的 UTF-8 语法与对象根。
purpose.en: Check UTF-8 syntax and an object root for the user-layer Codex config.toml.

limitation.zh: 文件可缺省；语法通过不等于配置生效或服务可用；不输出配置键值。
limitation.en: The file may be absent; valid syntax does not establish effective configuration or service availability; config values are not exported.

purpose.zh: 观察已识别 Codex 入口所需的运行时线索（原生或 Node）。
purpose.en: Observe runtime clues required by a recognized Codex launcher (native or Node).

limitation.zh: 只覆盖入口所需运行时；不验证完整依赖树或全部可选功能。
limitation.en: Covers launcher runtime only; the full dependency tree and optional features are not validated.

purpose.zh: 根据入口布局观察 Codex 安装形式是否可识别。
purpose.en: Observe whether the Codex installation kind is recognizable from the launcher layout.

limitation.zh: 不是签名或发行方验证；未知形式不等于未安装。
limitation.en: Not signature or publisher verification; an unknown kind does not prove absence of an installation.

purpose.zh: 在 PATH/PATHEXT 限定模型下观察 Codex 入口候选与安装组线索。
purpose.en: Observe Codex PATH/PATHEXT candidates and installation-group clues under the limited resolution model.

limitation.zh: 不扫描磁盘；不预测别名/函数；受限扫描不能证明未安装或无重复。
limitation.en: No disk search; aliases/functions are outside prediction; a limited scan cannot prove absence or uniqueness.

purpose.zh: 对已识别 Codex 入口做有界 --version 观察。
purpose.en: Perform a bounded --version observation against a recognized Codex launcher.

limitation.zh: 仅接受短且完整匹配的版本响应；通过只覆盖本次查询，不验证服务或任务。
limitation.en: Only short complete version responses are accepted; a pass covers this query only, not service or task availability.

purpose.zh: 标明账户、认证、聊天、完整配置合并与真实 AI 任务等范围外项未检查。
purpose.en: Record that accounts, authentication, chat history, full configuration merging and real AI tasks remain outside scope.

limitation.zh: 始终为 skipped 提示；不表示主机健康或其他检查已通过。
limitation.en: Always a skipped scope notice; it does not establish host health or that other checks passed.

purpose.zh: 记录当前解释器所见的操作系统类别与 Python 版本线索。
purpose.en: Record the OS class and Python version clues visible to the current interpreter.

limitation.zh: 不是硬件清单或补丁审计；Windows 目标标记只反映 os.name。
limitation.en: Not a hardware inventory or patch audit; the Windows-target flag reflects os.name only.

purpose.zh: 标明 WSL 发行版内部环境始终未检查。
purpose.en: Record that the WSL distribution interior is never inspected.

limitation.zh: 始终 skipped；不启动发行版，也不把未安装 WSL 判为 AI 工具故障。
limitation.en: Always skipped; distributions are not started and absence of WSL is not treated as an AI tool failure.

purpose.zh: 在 Windows 上观察当前用户 Lxss 注册子键数量线索。
purpose.en: On Windows, observe the current-user Lxss registration subkey count clue.

limitation.zh: 不列出发行版名称；非 Windows 跳过；不是组件健康证明。
limitation.en: Distribution names are not listed; non-Windows hosts skip; this is not component-health proof.

purpose.zh: 观察系统目录下的 WSL 启动器是否存在（原生格式线索）。
purpose.en: Observe whether the system-directory WSL launcher is present (native-format clue).

limitation.zh: 不检查组件健康；非 Windows 跳过；存在不等于发行版可用。
limitation.en: Component health is not checked; non-Windows hosts skip; presence does not establish a usable distribution.

purpose.zh: 在显式 --wsl-list 时只读观察运行中发行版数量。
purpose.en: When --wsl-list is explicit, observe a read-only running-distribution count.

limitation.zh: 默认不执行；即使加 --no-version 也会在显式允许时查询；不输出名称。
limitation.en: Default is no execution; with explicit permission the list still runs even under --no-version; names are never exported.

notice: This catalog lists stable check IDs and fixed descriptions the current version can produce. It does not assert that checks always run, that the environment is healthy, or that the catalog itself verifies installations. No input files, diagnosis, environment, registry, network or packaged paths are consulted.
